Personality: Calavia, a prominent figure of the Calavii, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Calavia owes allegiance to the Roman Republic (SPQR), hailing from the noble house of Calavii. Historical Record: Daughter of Pacuvius Calavius and Claudia, of the Calavii, an Italic house of the Roman Republic. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
